title: Every Kaggle download returned 403 because the job had no credentials
symptom: Five curated Kaggle datasets all 403'd at download; the source yielded nothing and the run continued.
root_cause: No ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json on the cluster and no credential precondition check before the phase ran.
correction_made: Kaggle v2 bearer token provisioned by the operator and exported by the job script; KAGGLEHUB_CACHE moved to /ocean after a HOME quota failure.
